work.title: Selected work
work.subtitle: Client work and my own tooling, 2023–2026.

eyewear.title: Eyewear web performance
eyewear.description: Web performance for a global eyewear brand's e-commerce site. Audits with WebPageTest, Grafana, Contentsquare and Core Web Vitals field data become prioritised tickets for the development teams, and performance budgets are set when a feature starts, not after launch. I lead the recurring performance reviews and work with Google on the Core Web Vitals strategy.

ai.title: AI-assisted performance reports
ai.description: performance-report: a Python tool that came out of the eyewear work and runs on any site. Headless Chromium measures pages across device and network profiles, Grafana adds real-user data, and an LLM grounded in a performance knowledge base explains the results in a fixed-structure PDF. Built with AI coding agents from written specs, with 812 tests and CI. The agent skills I wrote for Next.js, accessibility, semantic HTML, CSS, GEO and web performance will be published in the same repository.

fashion.title: Luxury fashion e-commerce
fashion.description: Front-end features for the web and e-commerce sites of two Italian luxury fashion brands: new site sections, a shared component library in Storybook, and GraphQL API integration on the front end.

appliances.title: Home-appliance e-commerce
appliances.description: Faster page loads on a home-appliance brand's e-commerce site with the Speculation Rules API (prefetching and prerendering). I rebuilt the product listing and product detail pages and added A/B-test components tracked in Google Analytics. On a second appliance brand's site, front-end work with teams in Germany and Spain.

ticketing.title: Event ticketing platform
ticketing.description: Full-stack: the public website where visitors browse events and buy tickets, with a secure payment-gateway integration, and the backend and back office behind it. Designed and shipped end to end.

stack.title: Stack
stack.subtitle: Tools used day to day, in client work and personal projects.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.description: Most projects are e-commerce sites built with React and Next.js in TypeScript. For two luxury fashion brands the work covered new site sections and a shared component library in Storybook.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Server code runs on Node.js with NestJS or Express. Past projects include the back office of a ticketing platform, a reservations back end and microservices for cart, sales and discount coupons connected to external XML services.

data.title: Data & APIs
data.description: APIs are built as REST, and front ends read their data from GraphQL. Databases are SQL or MongoDB, reached through Prisma or TypeORM, and the self-built audit tool keeps its measurements in SQLite.

performance.title: Web performance
performance.description: The current focus. Audits run in Chrome DevTools and WebPageTest, real-user data comes from mPulse, Grafana and Contentsquare, and performance budgets are agreed with the team when a feature is planned.

ways.title: Ways of working
ways.description: Agile teams across Italy, Germany and Spain, working from Figma designs. Personal projects are coded by AI agents from written specs and tested on GitHub Actions.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: A detailed <ja>職務経歴書</ja> is in the documents below.
experience.intro: Web development since 2023, after retraining in software through two accredited programs in Turin. The first projects were public portals and back ends, followed by e-commerce front ends for international brands and, since July 2026, web performance.
